summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of bondholder meetings for its 2010 and 2013 domestic bond issuances. Bondholders approved a proposed merger by absorption where Ecopetrol (surviving entity) absorbs Parque Solar Portón del Sol S.A.S. Quorum was 79.16% and 79.95%, with merger approval at 94.65% (2010) and 100% (2013). The approval does not modify bond terms. This is routine debt-holder consent for an internal merger, not a special situation. The merger itself is not disclosed in detail; no price, premium, or strategic review implications are provided. What to watch: any material terms of the absorption or potential restructuring impact.
